derivation.method: Remove provider PBR materials and textures; Validate mesh; weld coincident vertices; dissolve degenerates; recalculate normals; collapse decimation only when above target with validation between passes; triangulate and validate before measuring. Remove wire edges, split edges shared by more than two faces and remove zero-area faces (counts in quality.topology_repairs). Never subdivide to inflate counts.

captured_generation.external_reference_status: Text prompts only: no image was given to the image model or to Meshy. The prompts were written from an owner reference set of 10 images pasted into the Ginkgo session on 2026-10-03 (third-party photographs and artworks, described in runs/refset_1003/pass.json; never uploaded to a generator, not distributed). Note: runs/refset_1003/refs_contact.jpg is a contact sheet of the generated images and decals, not of the owner's references. Design-proximity review 2026-11-20: each generated image was compared with the reference photographs. The soft seat, bladder tank and canister are generic types in different forms and were imported (comparisons in each asset's reference_review); the pack unit and cube rover were excluded as close copies of specific third-party designs, and the lander as a replica of a specific artwork. Provider textures (the colourways that follow the references) are not distributed; only geometry ships.
captured_generation.dimension_basis: Real-world sizes chosen for this import, not the stylised scene sizes: soft seat 0.90 m high (a lounge chair with a tall round backrest; also the height Project Y2K v061 used), bladder tank 0.45 m (a portable collapsible water container with a carry handle; Y2K v061 used 1.35 m and the Ginkgo scenes were larger still), canister 0.65 m (sized as a portable extinguisher-type pressure canister; Y2K v061 used 1.25 m). Each mesh was scaled uniformly to that height; width and depth were measured after scaling. Not a physical survey.
captured_generation.reference_review: Reference image reviewed on 2026-11-20 at full resolution (1024 px): no lettering, logos or printing on the fabric, frame or blocks. Design proximity: The owner's reference photographs for this pass (10 images pasted into Ginkgo session 280c8dd8 on 2026-10-03; extracted from the transcript to a scratch folder for this comparison only, not retained or distributed) were compared side by side at 800 px with the generated image. The closest reference is a hi-vis inflatable cushion stool on a sawhorse frame of perforated angle and timber, printed with sponsor lettering. The generated chair takes the same material kit (quilted inflatable cushion, perforated angle legs, timber blocks, extrusion, carabiner, hose) but a different form: a low lounge chair with a square seat, a round backrest and four splayed legs, no sawhorse frame and no sack-shaped back. Judged a generic lounge-chair type, not a copy of that piece; the owner should confirm.
captured_generation.rights: Reference images generated on the owner's Higgsfield account (gpt_image_2_5, text prompts only); meshes with Meshy-7 image-to-3D on the owner's Meshy account (the same account, by the account ID in the result URLs, as the library's other Meshy batches). The Ginkgo pass records an owner approval on 2026-10-03 that covered generation for the GRANDWHIS world packs, not this library. The prompts were written from third-party reference photographs (see external_reference_status). Generator account entitlements not independently audited. Provider textures are not distributed.
